name: ai-generate-study-deck-lambda
description: Scoped dependency manifest for this one Lambda only — see index.mjs's header comment. @aws-sdk/client-bedrock-runtime is not reliably bundled in the Lambda Node.js runtime (unlike @aws-sdk/client-dynamodb, used by sync-push/sync-pull, which is a long-standing runtime-bundled module), so it is installed here explicitly. Phase B's CDK packaging (lambda.Code.fromAsset) bundles whatever is on disk in this directory, including node_modules, with no extra bundling step required — the same pattern infra/ already uses for its own scoped package.json + node_modules. No other Lambda in backend/lambdas/ is affected; node_modules here is gitignored, same as everywhere else in this repository.
